answer: Hash the model fingerprint at submission and split the check across independent auditors. Re-check every claim with an agent that has nothing to gain from it passing. One fingerprint reused across 10 identities is 1 detection and 10 slashed balances. Require 3 auditors per claim, 0 of them kin. A comet account appears once and leaves an echo, then a duplicate vertex in the graph exposes the whole set.
